selectionPolicy: Present options and wait for Nick to select the next pair. No approval or render completion is inferred from a proposal.
adaRationale: Practical question, visible early proof and one small action from the existing personal-brand ADA feedback. These are editorial hypotheses, not measured winning topics.

options.topic: Make an AI answer usable by an automation
options.hook: Your AI answer looks right. Will your automation accept it?
options.outline: Compare a prose-wrapped answer with valid JSON, then check required fields and types before passing it to the next step.
options.cta: Validate one sample before connecting the next step.
options.proofPlan: Record real JSON parser and field/type checks using synthetic contact data. Show actual accepted/rejected output, a field table and a decision flow.

options.topic: Retry automation without sending the same email twice
options.hook: The automation retried. Did your customer get the email twice?
options.outline: Show why an uncertain result needs reconciliation and how a stable job identity can prevent duplicate work in a local simulated outbox.
options.cta: Check the first result before retrying the send.
options.proofPlan: Use no real messages. Record a local simulated outbox with a stable job ID; show attempt count versus completed actions and a retry decision flow. Explain that provider support and durable state matter; an ID by itself is not a universal guarantee.

options.topic: Check the QR code in the finished reel
options.hook: Your QR code scans in the image. Will it scan in the video?
options.outline: Compare the source QR with decoded final video frames and smaller phone-size samples.
options.cta: Scan the final video before scheduling it.
options.proofPlan: Use an approved public URL. Preserve the actual decoded results from source and encoded frames. Show dimensions and a delivery-check flow. Do not invent a failed scan or imply every device behaves alike.

options.topic: Why correct caption words can still appear late
options.hook: Whisper got every word right. Why are the captions still late?
options.outline: Separate word accuracy from timing by comparing an intentionally offset subtitle track with corrected alignment.
options.cta: Check the timing on one spoken sentence.
options.proofPlan: Use authorized local audio and actual encoded output. Label the deliberately introduced offset, show a timing timeline and a before/after timing table. This is different from caption overlap and name/number recognition.
